nina (People Ops): Quick update: launching a Regional Holiday Swap pilot + clarification on bereavement leave eligibility. Please scan — short and actionable. :sparkles:
nina (People Ops): Regional Holiday Swap pilot: employees in participating regions can swap up to 2 company-observed holidays for locally significant holidays (e.g., cultural/religious days) this calendar year. Pilot window opens Mon.
jules (People Ops): TL;DR: swap 1 or 2 company holidays -> get selected local days in exchange. No net PTO change. Submit swap requests by EOD Fri using the swap form.
omar (eng): Which regions are in the pilot?
jules (People Ops): US, UK, Germany, India, and Brazil. We'll add more regions in Q1 next year based on feedback.
sophie (sales): Any manager approval needed?
jules (People Ops): Yes 1 manager acknowledgement required. Form sends a notification to your manager. If manager does not respond in 3 business days, People Ops auto-approves for coverage reasons.
payroll-bot: Payroll code for swaps: HOL-SWP-26. Swapped days will appear on paystub as "Holiday Swap" entries for tracking only.
omar (eng): If I swap a company holiday and later cancel my travel, can I swap back?
nina (People Ops): You can request to revert swaps within the same payroll period if manager agrees. Use the same form and mark "revert". We can't guarantee retroactive reversions beyond payroll cutoffs.
sophie (sales): How does this interact with global blackout windows?
jules (People Ops): Team-level blackout windows (e.g., release freezes) still apply. If your team has a blackout during a swapped day, manager can deny the swap for operational reasons.
omar (eng): Bereavement clarity pls? We've had some questions about eligibility and documentation.
nina (People Ops): Bereavement update: compassionate leave policy updated to clarify immediate family definition and flexible evidence options. Key points: 1) Up to 10 paid days for loss of immediate family (spouse/partner, child, parent) within a rolling 12-months. 2) Up to 3 paid days for extended family (siblings, grandparents, in-laws) with manager approval.
jules (People Ops): Documentation: we accept one of the following: funeral/home-service notice, obituary link, or a short manager-verified statement. We removed the prior requirement for notarized documents. Privacy preserved: docs submitted to people-ops are handled confidentially.
payroll-bot: Codes: BERE-IM (immediate) and BERE-EXT (extended). Submit via Workday: Leave -> Bereavement. If you need urgent payroll processing, email payroll@redwood.com with your Workday case ID.
sophie (sales): Is counseling support included?
nina (People Ops): Yes 1 we offer up to 6 free EAP counseling sessions and mental health days separate from bereavement. EAP link: https://wellness.redwood/eap. Managers, please be flexible with return-to-work plans.
omar (eng): Timeline for the pilot?
jules (People Ops): Holiday swap pilot runs 3 months starting next Monday. We'll send a short survey after the pilot and publish aggregated usage stats (no PII).
nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) If you want to swap holidays, fill form: https://forms.redwood/holiday-swap by Fri. 2) If you need bereavement support, file in Workday and email people-ops for a fast-track.
omar (eng): Thanks for clarifying. Appreciate the flexible options.
sophie (sales): Thanks team 1 will share with my regional leads.
nina (People Ops): Any edge cases, ping @nina or @jules. We'll host an office hour Fri 9am PT to walk through the form. :pray:
